questions.subject: DATA_SCIENCE
questions.topic: What makes a pipeline a pipeline
questions.learningObjective: State what makes a pipeline a pipeline
questions.stem: What makes a data pipeline a pipeline?

options.text: It moves and transforms data from source to destination
It stores data in a database
It visualises data in a dashboard
It trains a machine learning model

questions.explanation: A pipeline moves and transforms data from a source to a destination. Storage, dashboards, and models are separate concerns.

questions.stem: When is batch processing preferred over streaming?

questions.explanation: Batch suits high throughput and lower cost when latency is acceptable. Streaming suits low-latency needs.
